messages:
Marta (PM): Short sync to lock GA gate for predictor pipeline. Need clear owners for SLA text, runbook/rollback, week-1 oncall, monitoring alerts, and promo billing codes. Who takes what?

Eli (SRE): SLA proposal: 99.9% monthly uptime; latency targets p95 <=120ms, p99 <=400ms. Operational fallback: when queue_time >200ms for 2m OR error_rate >1% for 5m -> route to fallback-small-model and page oncall. I'll own SRE checklist (dashboards, fallback config, oncall rota).

Jess (Docs): I have API examples up. I'll finish runbook + quick rollback CLI and publish. Need Eli to confirm exact failover CLI for the doc. ETA: tomorrow AM.

Sanjay (Sales): Sales wants a launch promo 10% off for 60 days for up to 20 named accounts; finance OK with a capped spend. I'll own promo list, billing codes, and customer comms. Need product + finance signoff.

Dana (Product Ops): Monitoring minimums before ship: prompt_regression_rate (by prompt-set), token_cost_per_request, model_error_rate per version, and nightly canary smoke. Define alerts: P0 page (service down), P1 notify (regression signals). Ops-bot can schedule smoke runs. I'll own alert docs.

Ops-bot: Canary smoke scheduled nightly 03:00 UTC. Failures will post to #eng-sre and rollout dash.

Carla (Legal): HIPAA/Customer X asks: SLA exceptions only via signed addendum + DPA. Legal will draft the addendum template; no verbal commitments.

Marta (PM): Owners recap: SRE -> Eli; Docs -> Jess; Sales/promo -> Sanjay; Monitoring -> Dana; Legal -> Carla. I'll collate checklist and declare "Ready to Ship" once everyone reports green. Any other blockers?

Eli (SRE): Oncall staffing note: +1 SRE for first 72 hours post-GA and an incident lead for week-1. Runbook excerpt: if p99 >400ms OR error_rate >1% for 5m -> pin version, scale pool, then failover if unresolved in 15m.

Jess (Docs): Pushed runbook PR: https://git.repo/PR/689. Includes rollback steps and the curl healthcheck. Please review.

Sanjay (Sales): I'll draft the promo email and billing codes by EOD.

Dana (Product Ops): Adding alert thresholds to checklist now.

Carla (Legal): Will circulate addendum draft by EOD.

Marta (PM): Great. I'll update checklist thread with links and mark ship when all owners confirm green. :rocket:
